concepts.gloss_en: bread from heaven (the manna; miraculous livelihood without toil)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are the same fixed biblical phrase (Exodus 16) meaning 'bread from heaven,' appearing in the same paragraph of lesson 29 and both glossed as the aspect of manna/livelihood without toil. The only difference is a pausal vowel (הַשָּׁמַיִם vs הַשָּׁמָיִם), which is inflectional variation of the identical word — not a homograph. Single concept.
